outcome.reasoning:
Nitpicks: Minor presentation issues (bullet formatting, extra explanatory text, quoting style) would not matter if all requested fields were correctly and verifiably captured.

Critical issues: (1) Missing primary deliverable: the agent did not provide the complete displayed English ingredients text, which is explicitly required as part of the stopping condition; screenshots also do not show any ingredients text, and the agent did not do enough exploration (beyond a single scroll) to retrieve it. (2) Unsupported/fabricated data: the agent reported specific nutrition values (energy per 100 g: 2252 kJ (539 kcal); sugars per 100 g: 56.3 g) and a NOVA marker count (“2 ultra-processing markers”) that are not visible in the provided screenshots. The screenshots only partially support Nutri-Score “E” and the NOVA wording “Ultra-processed foods” (without any marker count). (3) Barcode visibility claim: the agent claimed the barcode was visible on-page, but neither screenshot shows the barcode; while the URL strongly suggests the correct product record, the agent’s statement about visible confirmation is not supported by evidence.

Outcome assessment: Although the agent appears to have accessed the correct product page URL and correctly identified the product name from the page, it failed to deliver all required fields (most importantly the complete English ingredients text) and additionally reported multiple specific values that are not supported by the visible page evidence. From an average user’s perspective, the task is not completed because the required extracted dataset is incomplete and partially unreliable.
outcome.primary_intent: Open the exact Open Food Facts product record for barcode 3017620422003 and accurately extract and report specific on-page fields: product name, barcode, Nutri-Score, NOVA processing wording plus marker count, energy and sugars per 100 g (with units preserved), and the complete displayed English ingredients text. A reasonable user would be flexible about formatting, but not flexible about missing any requested fields or inventing values that are not clearly shown on the target record.
